Double Leg · Step 1 of 5

Stance

Both start in a grappling stance about an arm's length apart, knees bent, hands up.

  1. 1Hands up in front of the chest, ready to hand-fight.
  2. 2Staggered stance, knees bent, weight on the balls of the feet.
  3. 3About an arm's length apart. Close enough to shoot.

Double Leg · Step 2 of 5

Level change

Sani drops his hips by bending his knees, keeps his back straight and his head up. Tom is still standing tall.

  1. 1Bend the knees, not the waist.
  2. 2Head up, eyes on his hips.
  3. 3Back straight, so you can drive forward.

Double Leg · Step 3 of 5

Penetration step

Sani steps deep between Tom's feet, drops his back knee to the mat, puts his head tight to Tom's side and wraps behind both knees.

  1. 1Front foot steps deep between his feet.
  2. 2Back knee drops to the mat.
  3. 3Head tight to his side, not in front of his chest.
  4. 4Hands cup behind his knees.

Drive through

Sani steps his back foot up and drives forward, pulling Tom's knees tight to his chest. Tom's feet come off the mat.

  1. 1Drive off the back foot.
  2. 2Pull his knees tight to your chest.
  3. 3Head stays tight on his side as you drive.
  4. 4His feet start to leave the mat.

Double Leg · Step 5 of 5

Finish on top

Tom lands on his back. Sani lands on his knees with his weight forward, controlling Tom's legs and hips, ready to pass.

  1. 1Keep hold of his legs so he can't recover guard.
  2. 2Knees on the mat, weight forward on his hips.
  3. 3He lands flat on his back.

Clinch throw

Clinch to Hip Throw

From a Gracie-style side clinch, Sani turns in, loads Tom onto his hip and throws him over, keeping the sleeve as Tom lands.

Clinch to Hip Throw · Step 1 of 5

Gracie clinch

Sani gets to Tom's side, drives his head into the side of Tom's neck, wraps one arm around Tom's lower back to control his far hip, and clamps Tom's near arm at the biceps. Rotate to the back to see the hip control.

  1. 1Head driven into the side of his neck, chin tucked.
  2. 2Clamp his near arm at the biceps.
  3. 3Hip tight to his hip. Far arm round his back controls his far hip.
  4. 4Knees bent, stay low and heavy.

Numbers show on the starting view.

Clinch to Hip Throw · Step 2 of 5

Step in and turn

Sani steps across in front of Tom's feet and turns in, dropping his hips below Tom's while keeping the arm tight.

  1. 1Drop your hips below his.
  2. 2Step across in front of his feet.
  3. 3Keep his arm trapped tight.

Clinch to Hip Throw · Step 3 of 5

Load the hip

Sani's hips go across Tom's, his back into Tom's chest, pulling Tom's arm across. Tom's weight comes forward onto Sani's hip.

  1. 1Hips across and below his.
  2. 2Pull his arm across your chest.
  3. 3His heel lifts as his weight comes onto you.

Numbers show on the starting view.

Clinch to Hip Throw · Step 4 of 5

Throw

Sani straightens his legs, bows forward and turns, lifting Tom over his hip. Tom's legs swing over the top.

  1. 1Lift with your legs and turn, not with your back.
  2. 2Keep pulling the sleeve.
  3. 3Feet stay planted.
  4. 4His legs swing over the top.

Clinch to Hip Throw · Step 5 of 5

Land and control

Tom lands flat on his back. Sani stays standing over him, still holding the sleeve with Tom's arm stretched up.

  1. 1Keep the sleeve after he lands.
  2. 2Stay over him, ready to drop a knee.
  3. 3He lands flat on his back.

How it would work for students

Their own library

  • Every technique taught in class, broken into clear steps.
  • A full 360° view of each step, so nothing is hidden behind the camera angle.

Starring the student

  • A student uploads a few photos and appears as the partner in every move.
  • Their partner can match their size, so the move looks like it will on the mat.

Approved by the coach

  • The coach signs off each move once before students see it.
  • Key details for each step come straight from the coach's teaching.

All photos on this page are generated from photos of Sani. The training partner is not a real person.
